topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct in the employee handbook; security commitments and sanctions in POL-01 (4.8); tested in the 2026-03-31 Type 1
Privately held with no board; the CEO and COO oversee security. Quarterly security reviews with the CEO start 2026-Q4
gap: No recorded security oversight meetings
remediation: Record quarterly CEO and COO security reviews with minutes

control_description: Security Officer, HIPAA security official, product security contact, and Privacy Officer designated in writing; reporting lines in POL-01
Annual awareness training; role-based secure development and HIPAA training for engineers with production access planned
gap: No role-based training yet for 14 engineers with production access
remediation: Start annual role-based training (POL-05 4.3)

control_description: Sanctions rule and policy acknowledgments; owners named for every POA&M item
Infrastructure inventory from code; SSP component inventory
gap: No SBOM for device cloud software; logs kept only 30 days
remediation: SBOM in every build (POAM-007); 1-year log retention (POAM-009)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved 2026-09-04 and published on the intranet
gap: Acknowledgments not yet collected
remediation: Collect signed acknowledgments (POL-05 4.2)

control_description: BAAs and contracts set security commitments to hospitals; customer security guide published in 2024
gap: No public channel for vulnerability reports; security guide out of date; BAA notice terms not in one register
remediation: Publish CVD policy (POAM-004); update the security guide; BAA terms register (POAM-016)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Security objectives stated in POL-01 and the SSP (Moderate categorization); availability objectives from the BIA
Organization-wide risk assessment completed 2026-07-24 with SP 800-30 (32 risks)
Insider misuse of support access assessed (R-008); no broader fraud risk assessment
gap: Fraud risk (for example misuse of PHI or credentials for gain) not assessed
remediation: Add fraud scenarios to the 2027 risk assessment

control_description: Major changes reviewed in design reviews
gap: No cybersecurity impact question in device cloud change reviews (P03 G-027)
remediation: Add security impact analysis to change and design reviews

control_description: Independent control assessment 2026-08-10 to 2026-08-14 (P07); SOC 2 Type 1 as of 2026-03-31
gap: No continuous monitoring metrics
remediation: Monthly security metrics to the COO (SSP CA-7)

control_description: Deficiencies tracked in the P07 POA&M with owners and dates; reviewed by the COO

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline and mapped to risks (SSP; P01)
Infrastructure as code; hardened base images; automated tests
gap: Container images not signed or verified at deployment; 3 legacy services run as root
remediation: Image signing (POAM-019); remove root containers

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies approved 2026-09-04
gap: Supporting procedures (production access, contingency, access review) not yet written
remediation: Write procedures

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: SSO with MFA; hardware keys for privileged roles; tenant separation in the application and database; bastion for administration
gap: PM-1 shared per-hospital keys; no independent penetration test of tenant separation
remediation: Narrow and rotate PM-1 keys (POAM-018); penetration test (POAM-017)

control_description: Accounts created from HR tickets with manager approval; hospital administrators manage clinician accounts
Role-based access; same-day termination
gap: 14 engineers hold standing all-tenant production access; no quarterly access review
remediation: Just-in-time production access and quarterly reviews (POAM-001)

control_description: Data center physical access is the cloud provider's (carved-out subservice organization); support and DevOps laptops are covered by full-disk encryption and remote wipe
Automated deletion of PHI after 24 months; provider media sanitization inherited
gap: No records of erasing the local trend buffer on returned monitors before refurbishment
remediation: Line 3 erase step with a record per unit (POL-04 4.7)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: WAF and DDoS protection; private subnets; mutual TLS for PM-2; no internet administration ports

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher on all external interfaces; HL7 over VPN or TLS
gap: Application logs with patient names and MRNs flow to a log analytics vendor with no BAA
remediation: Mask identifiers; BAA or move logs (POAM-011)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all endpoints; uploaded reports scanned; PM-2 secure boot
gap: Container images not verified at deployment
remediation: Image signing and verification (POAM-019)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Monthly authenticated scans; image and dependency scanning in CI
gap: No monitoring of device software components or the KEV catalog; no remediation time limits
remediation: SBOM matching and remediation time limits (POAM-006)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Cloud audit logging on
gap: No log review, alerting, or security monitoring
remediation: Weekly review and alerting (POAM-008); threat detection (POAM-010)

control_description: P08 runbook defines triage and severity for product security incidents
gap: Triage not yet exercised; device cloud events not tracked
remediation: Tabletop; incident tracking in the eQMS

control_description: POL-03 and the P08 runbook approved 2026-09-04, with notification matrix
gap: Not exercised; no ransomware runbook for the device cloud
remediation: Tabletop (POAM-015); ransomware runbook

control_description: Services redeploy from infrastructure code; backups with point-in-time recovery
gap: No restore or failover test has ever been performed
remediation: Quarterly restore tests; annual failover exercise (POAM-012)

control_description: Pull requests with a second reviewer and automated tests for all device cloud changes
gap: Emergency console changes not recorded or reviewed
remediation: Record and review emergency changes within 1 business day

control_description: BIA completed (P05); draft recovery runbook
gap: Contingency plan not approved; no regional outage scenario
remediation: Approve the device cloud contingency plan (SSP CP-1, CP-2)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Subcontractor BAAs with the cloud provider and ticketing vendor; cloud provider SOC 2 reviewed (Part B)
gap: Log analytics vendor has no BAA; no vendor oversight procedure for SaaS
remediation: BAA or replacement (POAM-011); annual vendor review procedure

control_description: Autoscaling of ingestion and portal services; provider default metrics
gap: No capacity plan or alert thresholds for the ingestion pipeline and database
remediation: Capacity alerts and an annual capacity review

control_description: Daily backups with point-in-time recovery copied to a second region; infrastructure as code
gap: Backups not immutable and share administrators with production
remediation: Separate immutable backup account (POAM-013)

control_description: None
gap: Recovery never tested against the 2-hour RTO and 15-minute RPO
remediation: First restore test 2026-10-20; failover exercise (POAM-012)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: POL-04 classifies PHI and signing keys as Restricted; PHI kept in the device cloud database and object storage
gap: PHI also in application logs sent outside the boundary
remediation: Mask identifiers in logs (POAM-011)

control_description: Automated deletion after the 24-month BAA retention period; provider sanitizes media
